definitions.fidelity: F=[Tr(Mdag M)+|Tr(Xdag M)|^2]/6, X=-i sigma_x; fixed target and leakage-inclusive
definitions.interaction: M_I=diag(exp(+2*pi*i*E*T)) M_lab, each saved truncation uses its own unchanged bare E
definitions.leakage: L=Kdag K, K=U[2:,:2]; worst endpoint=max eigenvalue of 2x2 L; identical in both frames
definitions.benchmarks: loss/anisotropy infidelity=1-[sum(s^2)+(sum s)^2]/6; coherent penalty=[sum(s^2)+(sum s)^2]/6-F_X; algebraic accounting, not unique microscopic attribution
definitions.return_timing: First sample at/after global peak with all subsequent samples below threshold; null if no return by T
definitions.state42_40: Absent from model; null is unavailable, not zero population
definitions.truncation_comparison: Adds states40..55, not a state42-only intervention; saved 40 and56 E/G blocks agree to numerical precision but are preserved independently
definitions.sampling: ~0.25 ns saved outputs; extrema/return times sampled, not continuous bounds
